items.title: SPHMC minimizer existence and unconditional q=2 initialization

source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. ASTIS supplies the omitted finite-dimensional minimizer argument and composes it with the q=2 proof edge.

items.statement: In the proof of Lemma 4.16 the authors select a minimizer x-star of the positively strongly convex potential, use its zero gradient, and then establish the initialization estimate. ASTIS expands the omitted existence argument and removes the extra critical-point premise from the already compiled q=2 squared-cost conclusion. The all-q concentration part of the source lemma remains separate.
assumptions: C2 normalized Hessian bounds alpha I <= Hessian U <= I with 0<alpha<=1.
The source small-gradient condition at xref and smoothing variance 0<=eta<=1.

obligations.label: Construct the minimizer chosen in the source proof
Discharge the critical-point premise in the q=2 initialization bound

bindings.boundary: Finite-dimensional minimizer existence and zero gradient only; no Gibbs law, concentration or transport conclusion.

assumption_deltas.source: The proof says to let x-star be a minimizer under the standing positive Hessian bound.
assumption_deltas.lean: Differentiable V and StrongConvexOn univ m V with m>0 on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space.
assumption_deltas.reason: The source C2 Hessian lower bound supplies differentiability and strong convexity through separately compiled adapters; finite dimension supplies compact balls.

bindings.boundary: The q=2 squared-cost component only; no all-q concentration, Picard dynamics, output accuracy, cost or complete main theorem.

assumption_deltas.source: The proof selects a minimizer internally from the printed Hessian assumptions.
assumption_deltas.lean: No minimizer or critical point is supplied; it is constructed internally.
assumption_deltas.reason: The new shared theorem discharges the previously explicit proof-interface premise.

assumption_deltas.source: Lemma 4.16 concludes for every q>=2 with an unspecified universal constant.
assumption_deltas.lean: The conclusion is the explicit squared q=2 bound 5 kappa d.
assumption_deltas.reason: This packet closes only minimizer existence; the all-q concentration input remains open.

assumption_deltas.source: The source uses R^d and positive algorithmic smoothing.
assumption_deltas.lean: Any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space and eta>=0 are allowed.
assumption_deltas.reason: The q=2 identities and zero-noise case remain valid.
